blocks.text: Langley condos and townhomes: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to October 2026

Over the 13 months from October 2025 to October 2026, listings of condos and townhomes in Langley peaked at 849 in October 2025 and bottomed at 561 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in April 2026 with 159. The reported sale price moved from $682,500 to $664,500, a change of −2.6%.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Langley?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 669 condos and townhomes listed in Langley and 136 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 20%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for condos and townhomes in Langley?
faq.a: The October report gave $664,500 for condos and townhomes in Langley, against $611,000 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do condos and townhomes take to sell in Langley?
faq.a: The October report showed 27 days on market for condos and townhomes in Langley and a sale-to-list price ratio of 98%, against 25 days the month before.

faq.q: What should I check on a townhome in Langley?
faq.a: Read the Form B, the bylaws, the strata minutes and the depreciation report, and ask about exterior repairs, pet and rental rules and who looks after the fences, roofs and yards.

faq.q: Are townhomes in Langley freehold or strata?
faq.a: Most are strata, either a building strata or a bare-land strata, with monthly fees and bylaws. Some are freehold row homes with no strata. The title search tells you which, and it decides which costs and rules apply.
